title: How to ACTUALLY buy a business $0 No Money Down
description:
Can you really buy a business with no money down? The answer is yes—but it’s not as easy as it sounds. In this video, we unpack the truth about no money down loans, how they actually work, and the risks most people overlook. From SBA-backed structures to seller financing and creative deal terms, we’ll show you the right (and wrong) ways to pull off a low-capital acquisition.

We’ll also cover the red flags that make sellers run, why some "no money down" offers fall apart, and what lenders are really looking for. If you're thinking about getting into business ownership without putting in a big chunk of cash, this video will help you understand the game—and how to play it smart.
